wiki.quote: Я лишь смиренный слуга Загробного Мира, но Узкий Лабиринт, как и все его скитальцы, принадлежит мне.

entries.name: Anti-Mage
lines: Blink can easily break Static Link and Counterspell reflects Static Link on Razor.

entries.name: Chaos Knight
lines: Razor has no way to deal with Chaos Knight's multiple illusions from Phantasm.

entries.name: Centaur Warrunner
lines: Centaur can use Stampede to break Static Link. It also prevents Razor from chasing Centaur Warruner or his teammates with Eye of the Storm, and Plasma Field's slow will do nothing to slow them down.

entries.name: Earth Spirit
lines: Boulder Smash's and Geomagnetic Grip's (upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter) repositioning and disables make it very difficult for Razor to keep enemies within range of Static Link and Eye of the Storm.

entries.name: Huskar
lines: Life Break along with Burning Spear can quickly kill Razor before Static Link steals enough damage for Razor to take down Huskar.
Berserker's Blood can make stealing Huskar's damage and using it against him somewhat dangerous, as Huskar will be able to inflict more and more Burning Spears rapidly.

entries.name: Morphling
lines: Static Link is almost completely useless against Morphling, as he is able to quickly break it off with Waveform or turn into Razor himself with Morph and recover all of his stolen damage, or simply steal Razor's own.

entries.name: Necrophos
lines: Necrophos usually doesn't build itmes that give attack damage, minimalizing effects of Static Link.
He can use Ghost Shroud to prevent Razor from attacking him with the stolen damage from Static Link.
Razor is somewhat vulnerable to magical damage, and Reaper's Scythe prevents him from escaping with his high movement speed when things get dangerous.

entries.name: Outworld Destroyer
lines: Outworld Destroyer doesn't care if Razor steals his damage because he does most of his damage through Arcane Orb.
Astral Imprisonment can prevent Razor from using the stolen damage from Static Link or chasing with Eye of the Storm.
Sanity's Eclipse will do a ton of damage to Razor due to his low mana pool.

entries.name: Queen of Pain
lines: Blink can instantly break Static Link, making it useless against her.
Queen of Pain doesn't fully rely on her physical attack damage, so she can still fight after being hit with Static Link.

entries.name: Rubick
lines: Spell Steal can easily steal abilities from Razor. Since Rubick get steal Static Link, Rubick can recover of his stolen damage, or simply steal Razor's own

entries.name: Slark
lines: Pounce can easily break Static Link, making it less powerful against him.
Slark is one of the few heroes who can man fight a Razor, because of Essence Shift.
Shadow Dance can prevent Razor from killing him and may provide an opportunity to kill Razor due to it preventing Razor from attacking Slark.

entries.name: Sniper
lines: His increased attack range makes it very hard to get close enough for Static Link, Eye of the Storm and Razor's own attacks.
Headshot procs will slow Razor heavily regardless of Storm Surge, as it will knock him back for a brief duration.

entries.name: Viper
lines: Viper's Poison Attack and Viper Strike that can slow Razor, and is one of the few heroes that can keep him immobile.
Altogether, Viper's skills reduce Razor's attack speed, heavily reducing the benefit of the damage drain from Static Link.

entries.name: Weaver
lines: Shukuchi can break Static Link with little trouble.
Time Lapse can easily be used to avoid damage from Plasma Field and can recover the damage done from Static Link and Eye of the Storm.
Eye of the Storm can't kill bugs from The Swarm.
Dark Seer can increase the movement speed of allies with Surge, breaking Static Link.
Any hero with teleport abilities (e.g. Ember Spirit, Storm Spirit) can easily break Static Link.
Heroes who rely on abilities to deal damage (e.g. Timbersaw, Tinker) can fight a Razor even after Static Link.
Town Portal Scroll transports the user away from Razor as he has no way to interrupt the channeling.
Linken's Sphere blocks Static Link and Razor has no other tools to pop it.
Lotus Orb reflects Static Link, wasting its cooldown for a long time.
Force Staff and Hurricane Pike are easy tools to break Static Link.

entries.name: Bristleback
lines: Eye of the Storm melts Bristleback's armor, and makes him much less tanky.
Static Link can completely drain Bristleback's bonus damage from Warpath.

entries.name: Earthshaker
lines: Static Link drains Earthshaker's bonus damage from Enchant Totem until he purchases an Aghanim's Scepter or Force Staff to break it.
Eye of the Storm and Plasma Field can disable Earthshaker's Blink Dagger, preventing him from initiating or re-initiating.

entries.name: Lifestealer
lines: Static Link cannot be dispelled by Rage or Infest, so Razor will be able to track Lifestealer down during an attempted escape.
Storm Surge makes it hard for Lifestealer to catch Razor.
Static Link can stop Open Wounds from getting any additional lifesteal, but keep in mind Lifestealer can still utilize Feast.
Eye of the Storm penetrates the spell immunity of Rage.

entries.name: Monkey King
lines: Static Link can steal the bonus damage from Jingu Mastery and reduce the physical damage from Boundless Strike. It also reduces Wukong's Command's damage if it's used after stealing damage via Static Link.
Static Link will give Razor shared vision on Monkey King if he tries to escape using Tree Dance or Mischief.
Plasma Field can prevent Monkey King from using Tree Dance and Mischief.
Eye of the Storm will remove the armor buff from Wukong's Command, as well as hitting Monkey King during Mischief.

entries.name: Phantom Assassin
lines: Static Link can lower the damage output from Coup de Grace procs, hindering Phantom Assassin's main source of damage.
Eye of the Storm strikes cannot be evaded by Blur.
Both Static Link and Eye of the Storm pierces spell immunity, as Phantom Assassin is often reliant on Black King Bar.

entries.name: Phantom Lancer
lines: Plasma Field and Eye of the Storm clears most of Phantom Lancer's illusions.
Static Link is not dispelled by Doppelganger or Manta Style which can be used to mark the real Phantom Lancer while also draining his base damage.
Razor's high mobility with Storm Surge makes it hard for Phantom Lancer to chase down with Phantom Rush. When upgraded with Aghanim's Shard, it makes a quick work of his illusions.

entries.name: Spirit Breaker
lines: Nether Strike can't remove Static Link and reduces Spirit Breaker's physical damage output.
Eye of the Storm melts Spirit Breaker's armor, and makes him much less tanky.

entries.name: Terrorblade
lines: Plasma Field and Eye of the Storm can help Razor clear waves of Terrorblade's illusions.

Static Link can significantly weakens Terrorblade's damage, even during Metamorphosis, making Terrorblade's attacks tickle while strengthening Razor's attack damage. Terrorblade also lacks escape mechanisms, making Terrorblade a good target for Static Link and forcing Terrorblade to buy Linken's Sphere.
Storm Surge makes it difficult for Terrorblade to catch Razor, and when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard, it can also deal damage to Terrorblade and his illusions.

Eye of the Storm can rapidly weaken Terrorblade's armor, which combined with Terrorblade's low health and strength gain can almost completely discourage Terrorblade from even being present in teamfights.
Static Link and Eye of the Storm cannot be dispelled neither with Manta Style nor blocked by Black King Bar, which can put Terrorblade in a big disadvantage against Razor.

However, Razor's lack of disables makes it difficult for him to burst down Terrorblade before he can use Sunder unless Razor has either Black King Bar or Linken's Sphere to protect himself against it.

entries.name: Troll Warlord
lines: Static Link is effective against Troll Warlord, as he mainly relies on attack speed more so than damage.

entries.name: Ursa
lines: Plasma Field can spot an Ursa sneaking into Roshan's pit
Static Link has a 800 link break distance, meaning Razor can stay close enough to drain Ursa' damage, but not too close to get attacked
Static Link cannot be dispelled by Enrage
With Storm Surge, Razor will usually be faster than Ursa in most cases
Eye of the Storm melts through Ursa's armor

entries.name: Windranger
lines: Static Link can lower the damage output from Focus Fire.
Eye of the Storm strikes cannot miss, even if Windrun is active.
Templar Assassin's Refraction will easily be removed by Eye of the Storm, and Static Link reveals Templar Assassin hiding with Meld and drain the bonus damage from Refraction.
Heroes who relies on high armor such as Fairy Knight, Tidehunter, and Pudge can be melted by Eye of the Storm.
Heroes that rely on right-clicks will find themselves unable to damage opponents seriously after being affected by Static Link, like Sven, Blood finding, and Juggernaut.

entries.name: Death Prophet
lines: Both Eye of the Storm and Exorcism deals AoE physical damage. Combined with Razor's armor reduction, the two can shred enemies and buildings in very little time.

entries.name: Shadow Demon
lines: Disruption will help Static Link steal more damage while banished.

entries.name: Outworld Destroyer
lines: Astral Imprisonment will help Static Link steal more damage while banished.

entries.name: Bane
lines: Nightmare allows Razor to easy steal damage with Static Link.
Fiend's Grip, like Nightmare, allows Razor to easily steal damage with Static Link.

entries.name: Luna
lines: Despite its short duration, Lucent Beam's stun is useful to help Razor steal lot of attack damage from enemy heroes with Static Link.
Lunar Blessing can give Razor bonus attack damage to help her farm during the laning phase and while Static Link is unavailable for Razor to use.
Eclipse and Eye of the Storm can often kill enemy heroes will little problems, especially when both abilities are upgraded with Aghanim's Scepter.
Moon Glaives and Lunar Blessing can help Razor push lanes of creeps and towers with ease when combined with Aghanim's Scepter upgraded Eye of the Storm.

entries.name: Naga Siren
lines: Ensnare will help Razor to fully steal an enemy's damage (preferably their carry in the middle of a fight) with Static Link.

entries.name: Winter Wyvern
lines: Cold Embrace doesn't hinder Razor's contribution to fights, provided that he has already casted Eye of the Storm, or is already stealing the damage of an enemy hero with Static Link.
Winter's Curse makes it easier for Razor to get close by and steal the damage of any affected hero with Static Link, or to reduce the armor of the affected target with Eye of the Storm.
Heroes with long-lasting disables such as Lion, Shadow Shaman, and Puck synergize well with Static Link, increasing its effective duration.

entries.name: Iron Branch
lines: Iron Branch adds to Razor's already decent starting attributes.

entries.name: Tango
lines: Tango helps Razor stay in lane with health regeneration.

entries.name: Healing Salve
lines: Healing Salve can save Razor by restoring his health.

entries.name: Faerie Fire
lines: Faerie Fire may keep Razor alive with burst health.

entries.name: Enchanted Mango
lines: Enchanted Mango gives burst mana so Razor can use Plasma Field to finish off his enemies in the early game.

entries.name: Clarity
lines: Clarity allow Razor to regenerate his mana during the laning.

entries.name: Regular Stick
lines: Regular Stick can help Razor get off.

entries.name: Boots of Speed
lines: Boots of Speed, combined with Storm Surge, make Razor one of the fastest heroes in the early game.

entries.name: Bottle
lines: Bottle helps with regeneration if Razor is playing in mid, as his superior movement speed helps him reach runes faster.

entries.name: Magic Wand
lines: Magic Wand grants attributes and more charges to restore health and mana.

entries.name: Phase Boots
lines: Phase Boots allow Razor to catch up to enemies and keep them within range of Static Link and Eye of the Storm.

entries.name: Drum of Endurance
lines: Drum of Endurance enhances attributes, attack speed, and movement speed.

entries.name: Black King Bar
lines: Black King Bar's spell immunity negates numerous disables, allowing Razor to keep up with enemies. It suits well with everything that Razor wants: To be in the middle of the teamfight dealing damage without dying.

entries.name: Satanic
lines: Satanic capitalize on the enormous damage you stole from the enemy and combining with Black King Bar, you would be constantly dealing damage, regenerating health and reducing armor from the enemy through your ulti.

entries.name: Sange and Yasha
lines: Sange and Yasha provides many bonuses including movement speed and status resistance, helping Razor keep enemies within range of his abilities.

entries.name: Aghanim's Shard
lines: Aghanim's Shard will increase the cast range (and break range) of Razor's Static Link, it will also allow Razor to put Static Link on alt-cast. When put on alt-cast, Static Link will pull both, Razor and the affected target toward each other at a speed of 100, similarly to Harpoon's active ability called Draw Forth.

entries.name: Gleipnir
lines: Gleipnir will give Razor ability to root multiple enemies at once in an area, making them easier targets for Plasma Field, Static Link and Eye of the Storm and will also allow his attacks to passively release a chain lightning that can bounce between enemies and damage them.

entries.name: Butterfly
lines: Butterfly's evasion make Razor more difficult for enemy carries to take down, so he can live and drain more damage.

entries.name: Refresher Orb
lines: Refresher Orb allows Razor to keep two instances of Eye of the Storm active at the same time, dealing heavy damage and armor reduction.

entries.name: Aghanim's Scepter
lines: Aghanim's Scepter will allow Eye of the Storm to strike two targets at once and to damage buildings while also reducing their armor, giving Razor great pushing potential and increased AoE efficiency.

entries.name: Monkey King Bar
lines: Monkey King Bar will give Razor extra attack speed and attack damage, and it also allow Razor's attacks to pierce through both, armor and evasion.

entries.name: Arcane Boots
lines: Arcane Boots will give Razor increased mana pool and the ability to regenerate his mana in the early game.

entries.name: Rod of Atos
lines: Rod of Atos will give Razor bonus health and intelligence, as well as the ability to root the enemies to keep them in range of Static Link and Eye of the Storm and prevent them from escaping with Town Portal Scroll.

entries.name: Mage slayer
lines: Mage Slayer will protect Razor against magical damage with it's high magic resistance, additional attack speed with Razor's Static Link and mana regeneration

entries.name: Eul's Scepter of Divinity
lines: Eul's Scepter of Divinity's Cyclone holds target in place so Razor can continue to drain their damage. Furthermore, it increases movement speed so Razor can keep the enemies within range, as well as providing a way to interrupt channeling like Town Portal Scroll.

entries.name: Blade Mail
lines: Blade Mail deters enemies from attacking, letting Razor stay alive longer when using Static Link and Eye of the Storm.

entries.name: Shadow Blade
lines: Shadow Blade allows Razor to use and pursue enemies with Static Link and Eye of the Storm with invisibility. Enemies cannot hear or see the sounds and visual effects from his abilities, but they will still do damage.

entries.name: Desolator
lines: Desolator will give Razor good attack damage and will also allow Razor's attacks to reduce enemy armor, which will allow him to amplify impact of Eye of the Storm.

entries.name: Hurricane Pike
lines: Hurricane Pike increases Razor's attack range and attributes, as well as giving him a tool to escape or position himself.

entries.name: Bloodstone
lines: Bloodstone is massive on Razor.Increases survivability, improves frontline presence and lets him heal from his spell damage.

entries.name: Shiva's Guard
lines: Shiva's Guard increases defense with armor and aura that decreases enemy attack speed. The active ability slows enemy movement speed to keep them within abilities' ranges of Razor.

entries.name: Assault Cuirass
lines: Assault Cuirass's armor reduction works well with Eye of the Storm. It also provides attack speed and armor aura to keep Razor and teammates alive.

entries.name: Revenant's Brooch
lines: Revenant's Brooch will give Razor bonus attack speed, armor, intelligence, true strike every 9 seconds and will also increase the speed of his attack projectiles. Revenant's Brooch can be activated to make Razor's next five attacks have true strike, deal magical damage that can ignore armor and weaken magic resistance of the affected target by 20% for 3 seconds, making them more vulnerable to Plasma Field's magical damage, and will also allow Razor's normal attacks and attacks from Static Link to attack ethereal units.

entries.name: Eye of Skadi
lines: Eye of Skadi gives a sizeable amount of health and attributes, as well as a slow to keep enemies in range.

entries.name: Blink Dagger
lines: Blink Dagger helps Razor get the initiative onto unsuspecting enemies as he closes in to wreak havoc on the enemy lines. Upgrade to Swift Blink to make Razor a swift chaser combined with Storm Surge's bonus movement speed whilst improving his damage output or Overwhelming Blink to evoke fear with its powerful magical burst and reliable slow especially casted along Plasma Field.

entries.name: Heart of Tarrasque
lines: Heart of Tarrasque gives Razor durability with strength and health, helping him stay alive and keep Eye of the Storm active for as long as possible.

playstyle.text: Razor is a fast, tough anti-carry who steals attack damage from his enemies, and transfers it to himself. He can quickly melt away armor with Eye of the Storm, allowing his team to finish off enemies with ease. However, Razor has no disables, and must rely on staying close to his targets and executing his abilities properly to deal damage.
cons: Dependent on well-positioned abilities to deal damage.
Less effective against heroes with higher mobility.
Struggles to recover well from a bad early game.

lines: Stacks additively with other spell lifesteal sources.
Razor can play in all lanes, but usually starts mid. Because of his speed and durability, he is not too dependent on supports.
Razor is durable compared to many carries, especially in the early to mid game. However, this advantage falls off in the late game.
Compared to other carries, Razor's attacks deal little damage. In order to hit hard, Razor relies on his Static Link to steal enemy damage, and Eye of the Storm to lower their armor.
Razor's abilities are dependent on positioning, requiring him to chase and stay close to his targets.
Razor's ability effects and sounds cannot be seen or heard by the enemy when he is invisible, allowing him to keep dealing damage.
Though the visual effect may appear to connect instantly, Razor's attack projectile still needs a bit more time to travel; so, get used to his animation to last hit.
Razor can get items to boost his durability, damage, or both, depending on what his team needs.
With Storm Surge, Eye of the Storm, and a few defensive items, Razor should aim to dominate the battlefield by placing himself at the center of team fights.
Try to catch enemies with the edge of Plasma Field's radius, as this will deal maximum damage and slow.
Plasma Field deals damage to invisible enemies, or enemies juking in the trees.
Since Plasma Field's expanding radius follows Razor as he moves, its range can become large. If Razor keeps moving toward the enemies after using Plasma Field early, he may catch up and hit them.
Use Plasma Field's wide radius to farm jungle creeps by hitting multiple camps at once.
Enemies can see Plasma Field's large area effect across any terrain, thus giving away his position. So, think when using it before ganks or during a Roshan attempt.
Plasma field grants vision for the whole plasma field area, even above hills or on top of trees. That's why it can also be used as a tactical tool.
More tips needed.
Level Static Link first to zone out the laning opponent, reducing their damage so they cannot get last hits. Conversely, it also helps Razor get last hits by giving him more damage.
In teamfights, use Static Link on enemy carries as early as possible to transfer their damage to Razor, neutralizing much of the enemy damage output.
Static Link is undispellable and pierces spell immunity.

Because of its cast animation time, try to use Static Link when Razor is close to the target. Using it from the maximum cast range will often allow the target to break the link before Razor can catch up.
Static Link will stay applied to Brewmaster when using Primal Split, and will continue to sap damage from Earth.
Blinking heroes like Anti-Mage or Queen of Pain_new can break Static Link with ease. Make sure to disable them or wait after they have blinked before using Static Link.
Consider putting an early point into Storm Surge if you or an ally (if you're in lane with one) needs some extra movement speed to escape or initiate.
Storm Surge combining with Plasma Field are ideal to farm between jungle camps since it deals damage to multiple unit and slow them, give Razor more durability when tanking camp.
Storm Surge can also be helpful if you're having trouble keeping Static Link on opponents due to movement speed differences.
Storm Surge is best used with items that provide bonus movement speed such as Phase Boots or Shadow Blade.
Eye of the Storm keeps lowering the enemy's armor with each hit.
Eye of the Storm is more likely to strike creeps as they have lower health than heroes, thus Razor should use Plasma Field to clear the creeps first.
Razor can direct Eye of the Storm to target an enemy by attacking and lowering that enemy's health.
Eye of the Storm prioritizes targets affected by Static Link.
Eye of the Storm can deal devastating damage to a single enemy, as long as Razor keeps the target within range, an easy way to get early kills.
Because Eye of the Storm reduces armor, armor reducing items like Assault Cuirass and Blight Stone will allow Razor and his team do heavy damage to an affected target.
Move between attacks to keep enemies within Eye of the Storm's range.
Take advantage of Eye of the Storm's long duration to activate it before fights, lest the enemies disable Razor first.

With Aghanim's Scepter, Eye of the Storm can target buildings, allowing Razor to push with ease. Combined with its short cooldown, Razor can apply pressure by clearing creeps and damaging towers. Bear in mind, however, that the Eye of the Storm will not hit filler buildings nor Roshan.
More tips needed.

bio: Никто из легендарных обитателей загробного мира не внушает такой страх, как призрак молний. Держа наготове свою молниеносную плеть, он охраняет порядок в Узком лабиринте, коварные и cпутанные коридоры которого направляют мёртвые души к судьбе, достойной их ума, способностей и упорства. Надзиратель парит над лабиринтом, выискивает замешкавшихся и стегает их обжигающим электрическим хлыстом. Судьба душ вершится их же руками, а разряды молний лишь подгоняют их либо к свету в конце тоннеля, либо к тёмным пучинам вечности. Беспристрастный и почти безразличный в применении силы призрак молний — извечное воплощение господства. Однако по его высокомерным манерам можно догадаться, что он получает от работы сардоническое удовольствие.
trivia: Альтернативное имя Razor было Gillette, что является известным брендом бритв и лезвий.
Фраза «Ride The Lightning» возможно является отсылкой к песне метал-группы Metallica из одноимённого альбома.

notes.text: При использовании Plasma Field прерывает произносимые способности Razor.
Plasma Field закреплена за героем и перемещается вместе с ним. Круг расширяется и сужается со скоростью 636 единиц; требуется 1,1 секунды для максимального расширения.
Дает летающий обзор в радиусе 700 единиц на 2,2 секунды, следующий за героем и оставляющий след обзора, длящийся 2 секунды.
Область поражения Plasma Field представляет собой кольцо радиусом в 200 единиц, находящееся прямо перед видимым кольцом.
То есть при использовании эффект мгновенно поражает существ в радиусе 200.
При расширении задевает существ на расстоянии до 900.
При возвращении эффект применяется после прохождения сквозь существ.
Урон и замедление применяются при расширении и возвращении волны, поэтому способность может поразить каждого врага дважды. Дебафф замедления складывается.

abilities.lore: Плазменная мощь держит загробный мир во власти призрака молний.
abilities.description: Герой высвобождает волну энергетической плазмы, которая затем возвращается к нему. Волна замедляет врагов и наносит им урон: чем дальше она от владельца, тем замедление и урон сильнее. Волна наносит урон дважды, при движении в обе стороны.
abilities.name: Plasma Field

notes.text: Static Link разрывается, если существо под действием способности умирает или расстояние от него до Razor превышает 800. Иные варианты не смогут разорвать связь.
Расстояние между Razor и целью проверяется перед каждым интервалом кражи урона. Если расстояние превышено при проверке, связь разорвется.
Поскольку связь использует дальность применения способности, то эффекты, увеличивающие дальности, влияют на её дальность.
Static Link при похищении урона дает общий обзор на цель.
Продолжит похищать урон, даже если урон цели достиг 0.
Вытягивает 1,75/3/4,25/5,5 (3/4,25/5,5/6,75) урона с интервалом в 0,25 секунды спустя 0,25 секунды после применения, срабатывая 20/24/28/32 раз.
Крадет до 35/72/119/176 (60/102/154/216) урона, если его вытягивали всю длительность.
Static Link отдает Razor приказ на атаку цели при применении и с каждым приказом на передвижение.
Способность позволяет Razor перемещаться при атаке цели.
Для отмены атак при передвижении Razor нужно отдать приказ на выбор существа или точки на земле, не связанный с перемещением или атакой.
Можно применять на героев, иллюзии и крипов-героев.
Несколько применений Static Link действуют отдельно друг от друга, размещая за каждое применение дебафф на цель и бафф на Razor.
При этом модификатор обзора не складывается. Он исчезнет, как только закончится первая связь.
При движении совершает атаки только по первой цели заклинания.

notes: Связь разорвётся раньше, если цель умрёт или отойдёт на расстояние более 250 от дальности применения.
abilities.lore: Полярность призрака молний тянет к нему электричество, высасывая силы из противоположностей.
abilities.description: Создаёт электрическую связь с выбранным вражеским героем, передавая его урон от атак владельцу способности. Пока связь действует, атаки не прерывают передвижение.
abilities.name: Static Link
abilities.shard: Увеличивает дальность применения. Пока связь активна, на её цель действует замедление передвижения, равное украденному урону, умноженному на ?.

notes.text: С Aghanim's Shard срабатывает только при попадании атаки вражеского существа в Razor независимо от расстояния. То есть способность не срабатывает от промахнувшихся атак.
Не срабатывает от атак построек и вардов.
Срабатывает от союзных атак. Срабатывание активируется союзником, но способность всё равно выбирает вторичными цели врагов.
Также срабатывает от направленных на Razor заклинаний, включая направленные на точку с возможностью выбора существа.
То есть способность не следует спискам механик «Отражение заклинаний» и «Блокировка заклинаний». Способности со снарядами активируют Storm Surge при запуске, а не при попадании.
Эффект Storm Surge применяется после активировавшей его способности.
То есть, если существо умрет от урона, то его способность всё равно сработает.
Радиус поиска закреплен за существом, на которое сработал эффект, а не за Razor.
Цели выбираются случайно без каких-либо приоритетов.
Если эффект активирован атакой, то он не выбирает вторичными целями невидимых врагов и врагов в тумане войны.
Если эффект активирован способностью, то он выбирает вторичными целями невидимых врагов и врагов в тумане войны.
Storm Surge сначала наносит урон, затем применяет дебафф.
Storm Surge использует псевдослучайное распределение

notes: Урон этой способности считается отражённым. Его нельзя отразить вновь, и от него не срабатывает вампиризм.
abilities.lore: Кто приблизится к призраку молний, в ответ получит шоковую терапию.
abilities.description: Когда владельца способности атакуют, есть шанс, что обидчика и ещё нескольких врагов неподалёку ударит молния, которая наносит урон и замедляет жертв. Этот эффект всегда срабатывает, когда героя выбирают целью заклинания. Из дополнительных жертв в первую очередь выбираются существа того же типа, что и обидчик.
abilities.name: Storm Surge
abilities.shard: Пока действует способность Eye of the Storm, молния бьёт с увеличенным в 2 раза шансом и уменьшенной на 2 сек. перезарядкой по всем врагам в радиусе ульта. Не может ударить одно и то же существо дважды за одно срабатывание.

notes.text: При применении прерывает произносимые способности Razor.
Eye of the Storm всегда выбирает первой целью существо с наименьшим текущим здоровьем в области действия.
Если в области действия несколько существ с одинаково низким здоровьем, то Eye of the Storm выберет среди них цель случайно.

Способность отдает приоритет врагам под действием модификатора обзора от Static Link, поражая их в первую очередь (даже при наличии других существ в радиусе действия), независимо от значения здоровья.
При наличии в радиусе действия нескольких врагов под действием модификатора обзора способность будет случайно выбирать между ними при каждом ударе.
С Aghanim's Scepter только одна молния будет бить цель под модификатором обзора. Молнии не поражают одновременно одну и ту же цель.
Если у двух врагов присутствует модификатор обзора, то каждая молния будет бить свою цель.
При атаках отдает приоритет существам вместо построек и игнорирует постройки для статуй.
Не снижает броню построек.
Разряды не являются ни обычными атаками, ни мгновенными, поэтому они игнорируют уклонение и блокировку урона.
Также они не могут активировать эффекты, срабатывающие от удара — (Counter Helix, Moment of Courage и Reactive Armor), и не сбрасывает перезарядку Tranquil Boots.
Разряды сначала наносят урон, затем снижают броню.
Дебафф снижения брони длится столько же, сколько и сама способность, либо до смерти Razor.
Не действует на курьеров, Рошана, невидимых существ и существ в тумане войны.
Eye of the Storm ударяет до 42/50/60 (50/60/75) раз и наносит до 2520/3750/5400 (3000/4500/6750) урона цели (до уменьшений).
Когда Razor становится невидимым, туча и молнии от нее тоже становятся невидимыми, но продолжают бить по ближайшим врагам, не становясь видимыми или слышимыми для них.
Eye of the Storm при смерти Razor мгновенно заканчивается.

notes: Каждый удар наносится противнику с наименьшим количеством здоровья в области действия.
Туча в первую очередь атакует героев под действием способности Static Link.
abilities.scepter: Позволяет способности наносить урон башням, казармам и Древним, а также атаковать сразу две цели.
abilities.description: Собирает над героем грозовую тучу, которая бьёт молнией врага с наименьшим здоровьем, нанося ему урон и снижая его броню.
abilities.name: Eye of the Storm

hype: Razor, властитель смертоносной бури, всегда готов к сражению. Он поджаривает врагов расширяющимся кольцом энергетической плазмы, а также лишает их мощи, наращивая свою собственную.
name: Razor
short: Крадёт урон врага, чтобы стать сильнее

talents.right: +6 к изменению урона в секунду у Static Link

talents.left: –0.1 сек. интервала разрядов Eye of the Storm
talents.right: +35% к замедлению и урону от Storm Surge
Вторая волна от Plasma Field через 0.8 сек.
